name: Jackson

neighborhoods.name: Belhaven
neighborhoods.homes: historic houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Jackson's rentals are mostly older single-family houses and apartment complexes, with many complexes in north Jackson.
climate: Run the taps to check water pressure and hot water, test the air conditioning and look for mold; summers are hot and humid.
fact: Jackson has had repeated boil-water notices since its 2022 water crisis, so renters should check water pressure and ask about recent notices.
